title: mentha × maximilianea var. suavis
intro: Mentha × maximilianea var. suavis, commonly known as Peppermint, is a hybrid plant of the mint family (Lamiaceae) and is known for its unique flavor and aroma. The health benefits of Peppermint include alleviating digestive issues, such as nausea, indigestion, and irritable bowel syndrome, as well as reducing headaches and relieving stress. The therapeutic actions of Peppermint include its ability to relax muscles, improve focus and mental clarity, and serve as a natural anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of Peppermint include menthol, menthone, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its distinctive flavor and aroma.
